summary: Verified 4 new UI/UX enhancements + backend regression. Backend: 41/41 pytest passing (added test_weekly_digest.py covering the new /api/v1/dashboard/weekly-digest endpoint with all required fields). Frontend: (1) Signup name persistence works — after signing up as 'Alex Tester', localStorage['vitality_display_name']='Alex Tester' and Dashboard greeting reads 'Hi, Alex Tester' instead of 'Hi, Grace'. (2) Remember Me checkbox visible on /login only (count=0 on /signup), checked by default (true), toggles on click, persists across page reload. (3) Weekly Digest Modal opens from Dashboard 'View Full Digest' link, shows real backend stats (64,490 total steps, Best Day Thu 11,690, 915 cal · 6% macro, 84 mindfulness min, milestones list). Share Digest button clicks cleanly; when clipboard permission is granted and navigator.share is undefined the fallback toast 'Weekly digest copied to clipboard!' fires as designed (verified). In sandboxed headless without clipboard permission it falls back to 'Unable to share right now.' toast (expected, no crash). (4) Achievements modal opens, Mindful Streak badge renders (currently unlocked with Flame icon and '3-Day Zen Streak — 3/3 days in a row' after prior test iterations bumped podcastStreakCount past 3). No console errors. Full regression pass on Dashboard/Activity/Profile/Podcast endpoints via existing 40 pytest tests.

issues: The immediately visible reminder-notification toast (app-toast) fires as soon as user lands on /dashboard after auth and can visually overlap / race with the intended 'Welcome to Vitality, {Name}!' / 'Welcome back, {Name}!' toast. Both toasts share the same data-testid='app-toast' selector so only one is user-visible at a time. Functional persistence still works (localStorage + greeting header both use the entered name), but the confirmation toast can be missed. Consider stacking toasts or delaying the reminder toast until after the welcome one has been displayed.

action_items: Optional: consider toast queueing so the Welcome (signup/login) toast isn't immediately overwritten by the reminder-notification toast on Dashboard mount.
critical_code_review_comments: WeeklyDigestModal.handleShare has correct fallback chain (navigator.share -> navigator.clipboard -> error toast). Note that in browser sandboxes without clipboard permission it correctly hits the final catch — behaviour verified.

Achievements Modal 'mindful-streak' badge's Flame icon swap is triggered on unlocked state — verified visually. The 'in-progress' Moon icon fallback path is a valid branch but wasn't exercised because prior test runs bumped podcastStreakCount above the threshold (a re-seed via `cd /app/server && npx ts-node src/seed.ts` would restore it to 2 for that branch coverage).

vitality_display_name is scoped to localStorage — clearing it means a returning user on a new device won't see their name until next signup, and greeting falls back to data.greetingName ('Grace'). Acceptable per the explicit demo scope.
test_credentials: Any valid email + 6+ char password (e.g. alex.tester@example.com / password123). Demo endpoint /api/v1/auth/demo needs no creds.
seed_data_creation: None. After test, podcastStreakCount may be > 2 due to modal-triggered listens in prior iterations — re-seed if 'in-progress' branch of mindful-streak badge needs re-verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The reminder-notification toast fires on /dashboard mount and shares data-testid='app-toast' with the welcome toast — when asserting on welcome toast text, capture it BEFORE navigating/waiting to /dashboard or add a filter for text content. Weekly Digest modal Share button requires context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=...) for the success path; without permission it correctly shows 'Unable to share right now.'. To re-test the mindful-streak in-progress Moon-icon path, re-seed to reset podcastStreakCount to 2.
